rca of the issue: RCA — /gift-cards blank page: in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 52 `const GiftCards = lazy(() => import('./pages/GiftCards'));` the lazy-loaded component is NEVER rendered — grep for 'GiftCards' and '/gift-cards' returns only this import.
